SURBHI KHANDELWAL

Senior Investment Operations Analyst

+91 9424785006 | surbhikhandelwal2310@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Investment Banking and Market Operations professional with 9 years of experience in End-to-End Trade Life Cycle, Private Equity Fund Accounting, Investment Operations, and Reference Data Management within global Capital Markets. Experienced in trade capture, settlements, reconciliations, corporate actions, security reference data, and market data validation using Bloomberg, Refinitiv (LSEG), and SIX Financial. Proven expertise in SOP development, process documentation, stakeholder management, and delivering operational excellence across Front Office, Middle Office, and global operations teams.

CORE SKILLS

End-to-End Trade Life Cycle, Investment Operations, Trade Capture & Validation, Trade Matching & Settlement, Fund Accounting, Private Equity Operations, Cash & Position Reconciliation, Corporate Actions, Reference Data Management, Security Master Maintenance, OTC Derivatives, Capital Markets, Exception Management, Break Investigation & Resolution, Asset Servicing, Performance Reconciliation, Static Data Management, Bloomberg, Refinitiv (Reuters), SIX Financial, Aladdin, Euroclear, MS SQL, Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP).

CAPGEMINI TECHNOLOGY SERVICES INDIA LTD

Senior Software Engineer | Client: UBS

May 2022 – Present

Key Responsibilities

Supported Market Operations and Market Data teams within a global Investment

Banking environment.

Managed Security Master and Market Data setup for Equities, Bonds, Funds,

Warrants, Swaps, Structured Products, and OTC instruments.

Maintained and validated Market Data using Bloomberg, Refinitiv (LSEG), and SIX

Financial, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across downstream applications.

Performed data quality reviews and validation activities supporting Market Data

governance and operational control processes.

Collaborated with Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, Technology, and global

stakeholders to investigate and resolve Market Data and Reference Data exceptions.

Supported end-to-end Trade Lifecycle processes including trade validation,

settlement support, reconciliations, and post-trade processing.

Created comprehensive SOPs, operational documentation, process guides, and

knowledge assets to support business users and improve operational consistency. • Prepared operational dashboards, MIS reports, KPIs, and management reporting for

business stakeholders.

Participated in UAT, process improvement, and operational excellence initiatives

focused on improving Market Data quality and process efficiency.

Worked closely with global teams across Asia and EMEA to support business

requirements and data governance objectives.

WNS GLOBAL SERVICES PVT LTD

Associate – Operations

October 2020 – May 2022

Project : Aviva

Supported Private Equity Fund Accounting and Market Operations. • Maintained Security Reference Data across multiple financial instruments.

Performed Market Data validation using Bloomberg and Refinitiv to ensure accurate

investment and reference data.

Prepared process documentation, operational guides, and knowledge transfer

material for internal teams.

Conducted knowledge transfer sessions and contributed to operational

documentation for process standardization.

Worked with business stakeholders to resolve operational issues, improve data

quality, and enhance process efficiency.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Supported Market Operations and Security Reference Data functions for UBS

across Asia and EMEA markets.

Managed Market Data validation and Security Master maintenance across multiple



asset classes using Bloomberg, Refinitiv (LSEG), and SIX Financial. Improved operational efficiency through the development of SOPs, process documentation, knowledge assets, and standardized operational procedures.

Contributed to Market Data quality initiatives through validation, exception

management, and continuous process improvements.

Recognized with the Star of the Month Award for outstanding stakeholder support

and operational excellence.
